compiled_state.title: [T2][GREEN] Add CWD-mismatch check and atomic write to commit-step.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/commit-step.sh (created by story 1283):
- Add CWD check: verify 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' from CWD matches expected REPO_ROOT; if mismatch, emit error and exit 1 (unless DSO_HARVEST_MODE=1)
- Add atomic write: write JSON to <name>.result.tmp then mv to <name>.result to prevent partial reads
Classification: GREEN; Dependencies: T1 (8ab2-95b1-34d1-4016)
